title: Income Tax Department Releases User Manual for Form 146
content:
# Income Tax Department Releases User Manual for Form 146

Ek important update hai. Income Tax Department ne Form 146 ke liye detailed User Manual announce kiya hai. Yeh manual CAs aur taxpayers ke liye bahut helpful hoga to ensure smooth compliance.

*   Form 146, jo ki ab Form 15CB ko replace kar chuka hai, non-residents ko kiye gaye foreign remittances ke liye ek crucial Accountant's Certificate hai.
*   Yeh form un taxable payments ke liye mandatory hai jo ₹5 lakh se zyada hain, jab payment non-resident (company na ho toh) ya foreign company ko ki ja rahi ho aur Assessing Officer ka certificate nahi liya gaya ho.
*   Iss User Manual mein Form 146 ko file karne ka step-by-step process explain kiya gaya hai, from assigning the form to a CA to online/offline filing aur e-verification.
*   Chartered Accountants (CAs) Form 146 mein remittance ki nature, Income-tax Act, 2025 ke under uski taxability, aur applicable Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) provisions ko certify karte hain.
*   Form 146 ek event-based form hai, aur isse remittance karne se pehle file karna zaroori hai.

## Read the Official Document
* [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/Form146UserManual)
